candidates.name: Mountain Valley Gas Pipeline (MVP) / MVP Boost Expansion
candidates.from: Wetzel, Braxton and Fayette Counties, WV (existing compressor stations)
candidates.to: new Swann compressor station, Montgomery County, VA

evidence.note: EQT October 2025 investor presentation: MVP Boost expansion upsized to 600 MDth/d; its slide shows a Northern Virginia data center demand marker beside the MVP Boost map.
Mountain Valley Pipeline application to FERC for MVP Boost: compression at three West Virginia stations plus a new Virginia station, in service targeted mid 2028.
Cardinal News on the proposed expansion and new Montgomery County compressor station.
July 2026: MVP letter to FERC defending the compressor station; opponents cite EQT's investor presentation naming data centers as a demand driver.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Compression-only expansion of P0220, +600 MDth/d, length 0, FERC CP26-14, in service 2028 (EQT says early 2029). Parent-system expansion with no row of its own; not P7829 (interconnect expansion). Data center tie: EQT investor slide shows Northern Virginia data center demand; shippers are utilities. Out of slice partly: WV and VA only, in slice.

seed_ledger.name: Adams Fork Data Center Energy Campus (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: no source says how the Adams Fork campus gets gas; Columbia P0169 is nearby but no source ties it. Same project as the other Adams Fork seed. Searches run: 6. Checked: WV DEP air permit notices and R13-3714/3715 permit (no gas supplier named, redacted); West Virginia Watch lawsuit and hearing coverage (FERC pipelines may be needed, none named); Ohio River Valley Institute (gas volume only); developer brochure (says adjacent to local gas reserves); GOGPT/aterio listings (leads only). Not found: FERC docket, WV PSC filing or utility filing for a supply pipe. Not searched in depth: FERC eLibrary, county records.

evidence.note: December 2025 lawsuit says FERC approval for pipelines that could supply gas to the plants has not been obtained; no pipe named.
Advocacy analysis of expected gas use; names no supply pipe.
State air permit hearing coverage; off-grid plants, diesel backup, no pipeline named.
